n86e3f6d3f0.headline: Cameroon - Consumption: Towards a decrease in the price of water and electricity
n86e3f6d3f0.summary: Starting next February, electricity and drinking water prices in Cameroon are expected to decrease, aiming to reduce consumer costs.
n86e3f6d3f0.why: Utility price changes impact household expenses and business operating costs, influencing economic activity and inflation in Cameroon.
